objective: V4.2 Input Intelligence — gate messy input, extend spark schema, chunk long documents, harden extraction determinism, and define promotion policy before retrieval/chat work.
context: V4.0 cognitive memory and V4.1 architecture are shipped on main at 4.1.0. Sparks ingest via cognitive_ingest + spark_extraction but lack intent classification, certainty/type fields, document chunking, and a clear candidate→active promotion path. Chat still uses legacy memory_items via build_prompt. Cursor owns implementation; keep slices small and test-gated.
decisions: Cursor implements all V4.2 tickets; Codex reviews via architect_handoff only.
Additive schema only — extend sparks columns; do not break validate_spark consumers.
Keep SPARK_LANES stable; add DOMAIN_ALIASES for finance→money, career→work, etc.

V4.2 implementation order is schema first, then intent: T2 must land before T1 writes or persists certainty-aware decisions. Rules-first intent gate before LLM extraction; LLM never decides store/ignore alone.
Do not wire cognitive context into chat in V4.2 — that is V4.4.
Preserve T18–T20 security gates; new input layers must not weaken them.
non_goals: Chat prompt integration or token budget work
Query interpretation or auto lane inference
Truth arbitration or user correction APIs
risks: Over-ingest if intent gate is too permissive
Schema drift without focused validation tests
Chunking splits mid-thought and corrupts extraction
Promotion policy promotes noise into active retrieval
qa_expectations: Per ticket: py_compile touched modules, focused unittest file, no full-suite requirement until T6. CROWLEY_TEST_MODE=1 CROWLEY_EMBED_PROVIDER=off.
next_action: Reopen/remint V4.2 T1 if it was closed by planning only; implement V4.2 T2 before T1 persistence wiring, then proceed T1/T3/T4/T5/T6.

approval.note: Approved V4 cognitive completion plan; V4.2 is first builder ladder.

tickets.title: V4.2 T1: cognitive intent gate before extraction
tickets.description: Add cognitive_intent.py with a hybrid rules + light-model classifier for memory intent: store, ignore, temporary. Depends on V4.2 T2 for certainty-aware persistence; before T2 lands, T1 may expose pure classification only. Classify before spark_extraction runs in cognitive_ingest.py. Rules must handle obvious noise, slash commands, and secret-like payloads; low-confidence paths default to store with tentative intent metadata downstream, never silent discard. temporary means no active spark and no normal retrieval; retain only receipt metadata/audit unless a later ticket explicitly adds an ephemeral store. Wire into POST /api/cognitive/ingest and sync path. Files: cognitive_intent.py, cognitive_ingest.py, tests/test_cognitive_intent.py. Non-goals: no chat wiring.
acceptance: cognitive_intent.py exposes classify_memory_intent(text) -> {intent, confidence, reason} where intent is store|ignore|temporary
ignore skips extraction and does not create active sparks
temporary creates no active spark and no normal retrieval result; any retained receipt metadata is clearly marked non-retrieval/audit-only
store proceeds to existing extraction pipeline; low-confidence store is tagged for tentative certainty once T2 schema is available
Secret-like and instruction-like input rejected or forced ignore without weakening T20 validators
tests/test_cognitive_intent.py covers store, ignore, temporary, secret/instruction input, and low-confidence tentative path

tickets.title: V4.2 T2: spark schema extensions for type and certainty
tickets.description: Extend sparks schema and validate_spark() with additive columns: spark_type (fact|decision|intent|observation), certainty (tentative|exploratory|confirmed), secondary_lanes_json (optional JSON array), exposure_class (public|private, default public). Add DOMAIN_ALIASES map for ingest/query normalization (finance→money, career→work). Update spark_extraction prompt to populate type and certainty when present; defaults for legacy rows. Files: sparks.py, spark_extraction.py, tests/test_spark_schema.py, tests/test_spark_validation.py. Non-goals: no lane enum rename migration. Must be implemented before T1 persists certainty-aware ingest behavior.
acceptance: setup_spark_tables() adds new columns with safe defaults for existing rows
validate_spark() enforces new enums when provided
DOMAIN_ALIASES normalizes external domain names to SPARK_LANES
Extraction prompt requests spark_type and certainty in JSON output
Schema and validation tests pass without breaking existing spark fixtures
V4.2 T1 can consume the certainty/exposure defaults without schema-order ambiguity

tickets.title: V4.2 T3: document chunking for long cognitive ingest
tickets.description: Add cognitive_chunking.py to split long ingest text into bounded sections before extraction: detect headings, paragraph boundaries, and mixed-topic breaks. Order: run a whole-document safety/noise gate only for obvious ignore/secret cases, then chunk, then classify each chunk with cognitive_intent before extraction. Each accepted chunk runs extraction independently; merge lineage back to one receipt. Cap chunk count and size to prevent runaway ingest. Wire from cognitive_ingest.py after whole-document safety gate. Files: cognitive_chunking.py, cognitive_ingest.py, tests/test_cognitive_chunking.py. Depends on V4.2 T1/T2. Non-goals: no new HTTP routes.
acceptance: Long input (>4KB or configurable) decomposes into multiple chunks
Whole-document gate cannot discard mixed useful input merely because one chunk is temporary/noise
Each chunk produces sparks with shared source receipt lineage
Mixed-topic fixture splits into separate lane-appropriate candidates
Chunk cap enforced with clear error or truncate policy
tests/test_cognitive_chunking.py passes with multi-section fixtures

tickets.title: V4.2 T4: spark promotion policy and cold-start alignment
tickets.description: Define and implement promotion rules in spark_lifecycle.py: tentative/exploratory sparks stay candidate; confirmed sparks may promote to active when confidence and validation pass. Add optional manual promote helper for maintenance/seed paths. Tune cold-start threshold in context_resolution.py so active+candidate policy reduces legacy memory_items fallback over time. Document precedence: confirmed > tentative in retrieval weighting hook (read-time only, no ranking rewrite). Files: spark_lifecycle.py, context_resolution.py, cognitive_maintenance.py, tests/test_spark_lifecycle.py. Depends on V4.2 T2.
acceptance: Promotion function moves eligible candidate sparks to active trust_state
Confirmed certainty required for auto-promotion unless manual seed
context_resolution active spark count reflects promotion policy
Maintenance dry-run reports promotion candidates
Lifecycle tests cover promote, skip-tentative, and stale/rejected unchanged

tickets.title: V4.2 T5: extraction determinism hardening
tickets.description: Harden spark_extraction.py for repeatable structure: temperature=0 on live calls, canonical JSON key ordering in parser, and a concrete receipt-hash idempotency table/cache so identical receipt text re-ingest returns the same validated structure in tests and production. Prefer a small SQLite table keyed by receipt hash and extraction schema version; use in-memory only inside tests where DB isolation requires it. Keep 1-retry-then-discard behavior. Files: spark_extraction.py, tests/test_spark_extraction.py. Depends on V4.2 T2. Non-goals: bitwise-identical LLM output guarantee across providers.
acceptance: Live extraction uses temperature=0 when provider supports it
Identical receipt re-ingest hits receipt-hash idempotency path in tests and does not create duplicate active sparks
Invalid JSON still retry-then-discard entire batch
Fixture mode unchanged for CROWLEY_TEST_MODE
tests/test_spark_extraction.py covers idempotency and retry behavior
